tagline: Execution-grounded, cross-stage drug-development benchmarks for AI agents
model_roster: RealBio roster (frontier flagships + Qwen/DeepSeek/GLM/Kimi + BioMate + Biomni)

benchmarks.name: admet_benchmark
benchmarks.task: Given a compound (SMILES), predict hERG/DILI/Ames/Ro5 class and physchem properties; scored over L1 intent -> L6 output validity.

benchmarks.name: docking_benchmark
benchmarks.task: Given a protein and candidate ligands, rank by predicted affinity (Spearman rho vs experimental Kd).

benchmarks.name: pbpk_benchmark
benchmarks.external_baseline: none (novel - no external PBPK ML benchmark; field is mechanistic: Simcyp/GastroPlus/PK-Sim)
benchmarks.task: Given a compound (SMILES), dose and route, predict PK (Cmax/AUC/t-half); within-2-fold vs published clinical PK.

benchmarks.name: boin_benchmark
benchmarks.external_baseline: TrialBench dose-finding (BOIN itself is a method, not a dataset)
benchmarks.task: Given a BOIN dose-escalation scenario, produce the correct MTD dose decision and safety flags.

benchmarks.name: target_structure_benchmark
benchmarks.task: Given a target (FASTA/UniProt), predict structure and detect the druggable pocket; leakage-controlled splits required.
benchmarks.note: structure_scorer.py (full L6) specified in the plan but adapter currently scores L1-L4; confirm before relying on L6.

benchmarks.name: rbfe_benchmark
benchmarks.external_baseline: OpenFE public benchmark; JACS-FEP (Wang 2015); Merck/Schindler FEP
benchmarks.task: Given a congeneric series and a reference ligand, predict relative binding free energies (ddG); RMSE + Kendall tau vs experimental, on leakage-controlled congeneric series.

benchmarks.name: qsar_benchmark
benchmarks.task: QSAR regression with explicit activity-cliff stratification.

benchmarks.name: novelty_fto_benchmark
benchmarks.task: Novelty vs prior art / freedom-to-operate reasoning.

benchmarks.name: ind_narrative_benchmark
benchmarks.task: Generate IND module 2.6.1-style nonclinical narrative; graded on skeleton completion, MRSD, adversity language, phase gating.

benchmarks.name: pipeline_e2e_benchmark
benchmarks.external_baseline: none (novel - no external end-to-end execution benchmark)
benchmarks.task: Grade a full pipeline run (request -> workflow selection -> execution -> QC -> interpretation -> report) against real terminal + S3 output artifacts.

benchmarks.name: cross_stage_benchmark
benchmarks.task: Causally-linked multi-stage reasoning (e.g. hERG liability -> reformulate -> re-screen -> re-estimate PK).
